controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color from Gaia's spectrum of the star; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of Gaia DR3's measured spectrum of the star, an F7 dwarf. Its fainter companion, WASP-76 B, 0.44 arcseconds away, falls inside Gaia's spectrum window and adds a little of its redder light. The spin axis is measured only on the sky, 61° from the orbit, so the display axis is celestial north. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 6,329 K and log g 4.11 (u1 0.368, u2 0.308): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

physical.credit: Radius and mass from Ehrenreich et al. (2020); Gaia DR3 astrometry; no measured rotation axis (display convention)
